title:
Christmas Support 🫶

While many rest on Christmas Day,
Support workers still find their way.
They show up with a caring smile,
And stay a little while.✅

They help, they listen, they understand,
Offering comfort, a steady hand.
Though they may miss their own cheer,
They bring hope to others near. ❄️

So thank you for the work you do,
For giving kindness all year through.
At Christmas time and all year long,
Your care helps people feel strong
 ☃️

#bluepitshousingaction #christmas2025
#supportwork
